pressure_text.text: Practically a vacuum: about 3 × 10⁻¹⁵ bar at night

temperature_text.text: 95 K to 390 K at the equator (about −178 °C to +117 °C), day to night

day_length_text.text: One day and night lasts 29.53 Earth days (synodic period)

made_of.text: The bright highlands are rich in calcium and aluminium; the dark maria are seas of cooled lava with more iron and titanium.
The crust is made of oxygen, silicon, magnesium, iron, calcium and aluminium, with small amounts of titanium, uranium, thorium, potassium and hydrogen.
The crust is about 60 km thick on the far side and about 40 km on the near side, where most of the lava seas are.
Water ice: 5.6 ± 2.9 % by mass in the regolith of the permanently shadowed crater Cabeus (LCROSS impact).

pressure_mbar.note: at mean radius; 4.0 to 8.7 mbar with the season

temperature_text.text: Average about 214 K (−59 °C); 184 K to 242 K (−89 °C to −31 °C) day to night at the Viking 1 site

air_text.text: 95.1 % carbon dioxide, 2.59 % nitrogen, 1.94 % argon, 0.16 % oxygen (by volume)

distance_km.note: closest and farthest distance from Earth

made_of.text: Mars looks red because the iron in its rocks has oxidised: it has rusted.
Winds are strong enough to make dust storms that cover much of the planet.
Water ice lies just under the surface in the polar regions.

The soil at the Phoenix site holds perchlorate: 0.4 to 0.6 % perchlorate by mass, leached from each soil sample. Perchlorate is toxic, so soil must be washed before it can grow food; hydroponics avoids the soil.

nasa.text: Grown hydroponically in NASA's Biomass Production Chamber: four crops of 90 to 105 days.
Biomass Production Chamber: five crops of 64 to 86 days.

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.role: The main protein and fat source of the set.

nasa.text: Biomass Production Chamber: three crops of 90 to 97 days.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.role: Fresh vitamins and fibre; very few calories. Fast.

sweet-potato.name: Sweet potato
sweet-potato.role: Carbohydrates; a second tuber crop next to potato.

peanut.name: Peanut

tomato.role: Vitamin C and variety; few calories.

best_set.why: Potato for energy (carbohydrates), soybean for protein and fat, lettuce for fresh vitamins. All three were grown without soil in NASA's Biomass Production Chamber.

isolation.text: NASA lists isolation and confinement as one of the five hazards of human spaceflight: small groups far from Earth, in a small space, react to it, so crews must be chosen, trained and supported to work well as a team

conjunction.text: About every two years the Sun passes between Earth and Mars (solar conjunction). Hot, ionised gas from the Sun can corrupt radio signals, so NASA holds off sending commands to its Mars fleet for about two weeks.

crew.text: On the space station astronauts slept just over 6 hours a night on average, although 8.5 hours were planned.
crew.base: Private, dark and quiet bunks in the habitat; a fixed daily routine.

crew.text: In the 520-day Mars-500 simulation in Moscow the crew moved less and less, and their sleep times drifted, over the mission.
crew.base: Timed lighting, daily exercise and a fixed schedule, planned with the crew.

crew.text: After 14 months at an Antarctic station, MRI scans of the crew showed a smaller dentate gyrus, a part of the brain used for memory, than in a control group (a small study).
crew.base: Analog rehearsals on Earth first, so the crew learns how isolation affects them before a real mission.

crew.text: A review of research suggests that tending plants can help the mind on long missions far from Earth.
crew.base: The hydroponic greenhouse is also a place to work with living things, not only a food source.

crew.text: NASA lists isolation and distance from Earth among the five hazards of human spaceflight.
crew.base: The communication room: live calls from the Moon, recorded video messages from Mars.

lessons.text: Lost because one team's software used English units (pound-force) and another's expected metric (newtons).
lessons.base: Check every number and every unit, end to end, on Earth before flight.

lessons.text: After an oxygen tank failed, the crew fitted a home-made 'mail box' to clear carbon dioxide from the lunar module and got home safely.
lessons.base: A crew that has practised together can improvise when a plan fails.

lessons.text: Designed for up to 5 test flights on Mars, it flew 72.
lessons.base: Hardware tested well on Earth can do far more than planned.
